pairs.target: tā xiàngshì yòu tǎng huí le jiālǐ .
pairs.english: It was as though she were lying back at home again.
pairs.hanzi: 她像是又躺回了家里。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn zài zào biān tiān chái , huǒguāng yìhuǎng , rèyì biàn cóng bèihòu tòujìnlái .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou fed wood into the stove; the firelight flickered, then warmth seeped in through her back.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶在灶边添柴，火光一晃，热意便从背后透进来。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng shuō bèirù hái shī zhe , zhāng le zhāngzuǐ , què lián zìjǐ de shēngyīn yě tīngbújiàn .
pairs.english: She wanted to say the bedding was still damp, opened her mouth, but couldn’t even hear her own voice.
pairs.hanzi: 她想说被褥还湿着，张了张嘴，却连自己的声音也听不见。

pairs.target: nà gǔ rè hūrán wǎng shēntǐ lǐ chén .
pairs.english: The heat suddenly sank inward through her body.
pairs.hanzi: 那股热忽然往身体里沉。

pairs.target: jiān bèi , zhǐjié , lián yágēn dōu suān qǐlái , xiàng yǒurén bǎ tā yìdiǎndiǎn quán jǐn , yòu mànmàn sōngkāi .
pairs.english: Her shoulders and back, her knuckles—even the roots of her teeth—all began to ache, as if someone were curling her tighter bit by bit, then slowly letting go.
pairs.hanzi: 肩背、指节，连牙根都酸起来，像有人把她一点点蜷紧，又慢慢松开。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào zìjǐ shìbushì hái zài wǎng xiàluò , xiǎng zhǎo gè dìfāng zhuāzhù , shǒu què bùtīngshǐhuàn .
pairs.english: She didn’t know whether she was still falling; she wanted to find a place to hold on, but her hands wouldn’t obey.
pairs.hanzi: 她不知道自己是不是还在往下落，想找个地方抓住，手却不听使唤。

pairs.target: zài zhēngyǎn shí , liǎn páng yǒu yíkuài shítou .
pairs.english: When she opened her eyes again, there was a stone beside her face.
pairs.hanzi: 再睁眼时，脸旁有一块石头。

pairs.target: tā dīng zhe kàn le xǔjiǔ , cái fēnqīng tiē zài shí shàng de búshì tóufa , shì jǐgēn hēisè de cǎo .
pairs.english: She stared for a long while before making out that what clung to the stone wasn’t hair, but a few black strands of grass.
pairs.hanzi: 她盯着看了许久，才分清贴在石上的不是头发，是几根黑色的草。

pairs.target: cǎo jiān suízhe shuǐ huàng , shíbushí sǎo guò tā de zuǐjiǎo .
pairs.english: The grass tips swayed with the water, brushing the corner of her mouth now and then.
pairs.hanzi: 草尖随着水晃，时不时扫过她的嘴角。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng bǎ liǎn yíkāi , yāo cè hūrán téng dé yì chōu , yǎnqián yòu àn xiàqù .
pairs.english: She tried to move her face away, but her side suddenly clenched in pain and her sight darkened again.
pairs.hanzi: 她想把脸移开，腰侧忽然疼得一抽，眼前又暗下去。

pairs.target: guò le hǎo yíhuìer , tā cái chóngxīn tīngjiàn shuǐshēng .
pairs.english: Only after a long while did she hear the water again.
pairs.hanzi: 过了好一会儿，她才重新听见水声。

pairs.target: zuǐlǐ yǒu tiěxiù wèi , shétou tiēzhe shàngè , yàn bú dòng .
pairs.english: Her mouth tasted of rust; her tongue lay against her palate, and she couldn’t swallow.
pairs.hanzi: 嘴里有铁锈味，舌头贴着上颚，咽不动。

pairs.target: tā fú zhe , liǎn piānxiàng yìbiān , xiàbā yā zài shí léng shàng , bànbiān jiānbǎng hé xiōngkǒu gē zài qiǎnqiǎnde shíkǎn lǐ , yāo cè dǐ zhe shíkǎn de nèiyán .
pairs.english: She lay face down with her head turned aside, chin resting on a stone edge; part of her shoulder and chest lay in a shallow stone recess, her side pressed against its inner rim.
pairs.hanzi: 她伏着，脸偏向一边，下巴压在石棱上，半边肩膀和胸口搁在浅浅的石坎里，腰侧抵着石坎的内沿。

pairs.target: tuǐ hái jìn zhe shuǐ , shuǐ cóng shēnxià jǐguòqù , pèngshàng jiǎo biān de shítou , cháo yòuzhuǎn zǒu le .
pairs.english: Her legs were still immersed in water; the flow squeezed past beneath her, struck the stones by her feet and turned away to the right.
pairs.hanzi: 腿还浸着水，水从身下挤过去，碰上脚边的石头，朝右转走了。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào zìjǐ zài zhèlǐ tǎng le duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: She didn't know how long she'd been lying here.
pairs.hanzi: 她不知道自己在这里躺了多久。

pairs.target: tóudǐng hěn dī , jǐkuài shíbǎn xiéyā zhe , zhī liúxià yídào xìfèng .
pairs.english: The roof was very low overhead, several slabs pressing down at an angle, leaving only a narrow crack.
pairs.hanzi: 头顶很低，几块石板斜压着，只留下一道细缝。

pairs.target: huībái de guāng cóng fèng hòu tòujìnlái , zhàobúdào tā shēnshàng , jièzhe shuǐmiàn de yìdiǎn fǎnguāng , miǎnqiǎng néng kànqīng jìnchù de qiáng .
pairs.english: Gray-white light seeped through from beyond the crack without reaching her body; by a faint reflection from the water, she could just make out the nearby wall.
pairs.hanzi: 灰白的光从缝后透进来，照不到她身上，借着水面的一点反光，勉强能看清近处的墙。

pairs.target: láishí de shuǐdào zhé zài hòutou , qiángjiǎo dǎng zhe , kànbúdào shàngmiàn .
pairs.english: The channel she’d come down bent behind her; a wall corner blocked the view above.
pairs.hanzi: 来时的水道折在后头，墙角挡着，看不到上面。

pairs.target: lín zhào dòngledòng zuǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao moved her lips.
pairs.hanzi: 林照动了动嘴。

pairs.target: " shào shīfu . "
pairs.english: “Master Shao.”
pairs.hanzi: “邵师傅。”

pairs.target: shēngyīn cā zhe hóulóng chūlái , qīng dé lián tā zìjǐ yě méi tīng quán .
pairs.english: The sound scraped out through her throat, so faint that even she couldn’t hear it all.
pairs.hanzi: 声音擦着喉咙出来，轻得连她自己也没听全。

pairs.target: tā děng le yízhèn , yòu jiào le yìshēng .
pairs.english: She waited a while, then called once more.
pairs.hanzi: 她等了一阵，又叫了一声。

pairs.target: shuǐ réng cóng jiǎo biān zǒu , shíbǎn dǐxià méiyǒu biéde xiǎngdòng .
pairs.english: Water still ran past her feet; beneath the slabs there was no other sound.
pairs.hanzi: 水仍从脚边走，石板底下没有别的响动。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎn táigāo yìdiǎn , xiǎng zài hǎn , xiōngkǒu xiān biē chū yízhèn hāi .
pairs.english: She lifted her face a little to call again, but a cough forced its way out of her chest first.
pairs.hanzi: 她把脸抬高一点，想再喊，胸口先憋出一阵咳。

pairs.target: yāo cè suízhī yī tiào , téng dé tā suō zhù le , étóu dǐ huí shí shàng .
pairs.english: Her side throbbed with it, and the pain made her curl in, resting her forehead back on the stone.
pairs.hanzi: 腰侧随之一跳，疼得她缩住了，额头抵回石上。

pairs.target: nà zhī dǐ zài jiānshàng de shǒu , hūrán yòu huílái le .
pairs.english: Suddenly the hand that was pressed to her shoulder was there again.
pairs.hanzi: 那只抵在肩上的手，忽然又回来了。

pairs.target: tā quánshēn yì jiāng , zhídào shuǐ pèngshàng xiémiàn , cái zhīdào shēnhòu méiyǒu rén .
pairs.english: Her whole body went rigid; only when water touched her shoe did she realize there was nobody behind her.
pairs.hanzi: 她全身一僵，直到水碰上鞋面，才知道身后没有人。

pairs.target: zhèlǐ méiyǒu bàn qiáng , zhǐyǒu yíduàn yā dé hěn dī de shídǐng .
pairs.english: There was no half-wall here, only a stretch of stone roof pressing very low.
pairs.hanzi: 这里没有半墙，只有一段压得很低的石顶。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu shuō guò de nàjùhuà què tiēzhe ěrduo , yí zì yě méi sàn .
pairs.english: Yet the words Shen Yanzhou had spoken stayed close against her ear; not a single word had faded.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟说过的那句话却贴着耳朵，一字也没散。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn nàbiān , wǒhuì zhàokàn .
pairs.english: As for Aunt Zhou, I will look after her.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶那边，我会照看。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zhuāzhù guò tā de yīxiù .
pairs.english: She remembered how she had caught his sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 她想起自己抓住过他的衣袖。

pairs.target: nà yìdiǎn bùliào míngmíng hái zài shǒulǐ , jiǎoxià què xiān kōng le .
pairs.english: That scrap of cloth had unmistakably still been in her hand, yet the ground had gone out from under her feet first.
pairs.hanzi: 那一点布料明明还在手里，脚下却先空了。

pairs.target: tā zuàn le yíxiàshǒu , jiùshāng zài zhǎngxīn chěkāi shìde téng , shǒulǐ shénme yě méiyǒu .
pairs.english: She clenched her hand once; the old wound in her palm hurt as though tearing open, and there was nothing in her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她攥了一下手，旧伤在掌心扯开似的疼，手里什么也没有。

pairs.target: bùnéng zài tǎng zài shuǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: She couldn't keep lying in the water.
pairs.hanzi: 不能再躺在水里。

pairs.target: tā shì zhe qūqǐ yìtiáo tuǐ , xītóu néngdòng , jiǎozhǐ yě néngdòng , zhǐshì lěng dé bú xiàng zìjǐ de .
pairs.english: She tried bending one leg: the knee could move, and the toes could move too; they were just so cold they no longer felt like her own.
pairs.hanzi: 她试着屈起一条腿，膝头能动，脚趾也能动，只是冷得不像自己的。

pairs.target: lìng yìtiáo tuǐ wǎng huíshōu shí , xié jiān kǎ zài shí xià .
pairs.english: As she drew the other leg back, the toe of her shoe caught beneath a stone.
pairs.hanzi: 另一条腿往回收时，鞋尖卡在石下。

pairs.target: tā bùgǎn yìng zhuài , tiēzhe shí dǐ mànmàn zhuǎn jiǎo , děng xiémiàn sōngkāi , cái bǎ jiǎo chōu huílái .
pairs.english: She dared not yank hard; slowly turning her foot along the underside of the stone, she waited until the shoe came loose before drawing her foot back.
pairs.hanzi: 她不敢硬拽，贴着石底慢慢转脚，等鞋面松开，才把脚抽回来。

pairs.target: yāo cè de yīliào zhānzhù le .
pairs.english: The clothing at her side had stuck fast.
pairs.hanzi: 腰侧的衣料粘住了。

pairs.target: tā yòng méi bāo bù de shǒu tàn guòqù , xiān mō dào yìcéng shīlěng , yāxiàqù , dǐxià què háiyǒu wēnrè wǎng wài mào .
pairs.english: She felt around with her unbandaged hand: first came a layer of wet cold, then warmth still welling beneath it when she pressed.
pairs.hanzi: 她用没包布的手探过去，先摸到一层湿冷，压下去，底下却还有温热往外冒。

pairs.target: zhǐtou pèng zhe yī kǒu , biàn téng dé fāchàn , tā bùgǎn zài mō shēn , zhī bǎshǒu àn zài nàlǐ .
pairs.english: Touching the torn clothing made her fingers tremble with pain; she dared not probe deeper, just held her hand pressed there.
pairs.hanzi: 指头碰着衣口，便疼得发颤，她不敢再摸深，只把手按在那里。

pairs.target: shíkǎn zài tā xiōngqián xiàng lǐ āo le yìdiǎn , zài wǎng lǐ shì kuài méi jìnshuǐ de dìfāng , zhǎidé lián shēnzi dōu tǎng bùpíng .
pairs.english: The stone shelf dipped inward a little in front of her chest; farther in was a patch above the water, so narrow she couldn’t even lie flat.
pairs.hanzi: 石坎在她胸前向里凹了一点，再往里是块没浸水的地方，窄得连身子都躺不平。

pairs.target: tā dīngzhù nà kuàishí miàn , táiqǐ zhǒu , xiǎng wǎngqián nuó .
pairs.english: She fixed her eyes on that stone surface, raised an elbow and tried to shift forward.
pairs.hanzi: 她盯住那块石面，抬起肘，想往前挪。

pairs.target: dìyīcì zhī nuó le bàn zhǎng , tuǐ yì dēng , shēnzi yòu huá huíqù .
pairs.english: The first time she moved only half a palm’s breadth; a push of her leg sent her body sliding back again.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次只挪了半掌，腿一蹬，身子又滑回去。

pairs.target: tā tíngxiàlái , chuǎn dé hóulóng lǐ zhí xiǎng .
pairs.english: She stopped, her breathing rasping steadily in her throat.
pairs.hanzi: 她停下来，喘得喉咙里直响。

pairs.target: fāngcái nà gǔ rè yǐjīng tuì le , zhǐjiān què jiànjiàn yǒu le zhījué .
pairs.english: The heat from before had already ebbed, yet feeling was gradually returning to her fingertips.
pairs.hanzi: 方才那股热已经退了，指尖却渐渐有了知觉。

pairs.target: tā néng fēnqīng zhǎng xià nǎ yíchù shì bù , nǎ yíchù shì shí , lián bèi yā má de gēbo yě kāishǐ yìzhēn yizhēn dì téng .
pairs.english: She could tell which patch beneath her palm was cloth and which other patch was stone; even the arm numbed by pressure was also beginning to prickle with pain.
pairs.hanzi: 她能分清掌下哪一处是布，哪一处是石，连被压麻的胳膊也开始一针一针地疼。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào zhè shì hǎo shì huài , zhǐpà zài yí bìyǎn , jiù yòu shénme dōu bù zhīdào le .
pairs.english: She didn’t know whether that was good or bad; she only feared that if she closed her eyes again, she would once more know nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 她不知道这是好是坏，只怕再一闭眼，就又什么都不知道了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ méi shāng de nà zhī shǒu chēng wěn , xiān jiāng xīgài cèng shàng shíkǎn , zài yìdiǎndiǎn tuōdòng yāo .
pairs.english: She braced her uninjured hand, first scraped her knee up onto the shelf, then dragged her waist along bit by bit.
pairs.hanzi: 她把没伤的那只手撑稳，先将膝盖蹭上石坎，再一点点拖动腰。

pairs.target: shī yīliào zài shí miànshàng mó guòqù , tā yǎozhù yá , nuó yíxià biàn tíng yízhèn , zhídào jiǎogēn yě lí le shuǐ , cái cè zhe shēn quán jìnqù .
pairs.english: Wet clothing scraped over stone; she clenched her teeth, pausing a while after each small shift, until even her heels were out of the water before curling into the recess sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 湿衣料在石面上磨过去，她咬住牙，挪一下便停一阵，直到脚跟也离了水，才侧着身蜷进去。

pairs.target: shuǐnáng hái guà zài yāojiān , yā dé tā téng .
pairs.english: The waterskin still hung at her waist, pressing painfully against her.
pairs.hanzi: 水囊还挂在腰间，压得她疼。

pairs.target: tā jiěkāi jìshéng , jiāng tā fàngzài liǎn páng , yòu qù mō yāodài .
pairs.english: She untied its cord, set it beside her face, then felt for the waist pouch.
pairs.hanzi: 她解开系绳，将它放在脸旁，又去摸腰袋。

pairs.target: dàikǒu de jié hái zài , chě le jǐxià cái sōng ,
pairs.english: The knot at the pouch’s mouth was still there; only after several tugs did it loosen.
pairs.hanzi: 袋口的结还在，扯了几下才松，

pairs.target: bù guǒ zhe bǐng hé dòuzǐ , wàijiǎo yǐjīng shī le .
pairs.english: The cloth wrapped the flatbread and beans, its outer corner already wet.
pairs.hanzi: 布裹着饼和豆子，外角已经湿了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bù chōuchūlái , lǐmiàn zhé zhe de nà céng hái suàn gānjìng .
pairs.english: She pulled out the cloth; the folded inner layer was still fairly clean.
pairs.hanzi: 她把布抽出来，里面折着的那层还算干净。

pairs.target: shǒu yì líkāi yāo cè , yīfu dǐxià biàn mànmàn màn kāi yípiàn shī .
pairs.english: As soon as her hand left her side, a patch of wetness slowly spread beneath her clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 手一离开腰侧，衣服底下便慢慢漫开一片湿。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn bǎ bù dié hòu , gé zhe pòkǒu ànzhù .
pairs.english: She quickly folded the cloth thick and pressed it over the tear.
pairs.hanzi: 她赶紧把布叠厚，隔着破口按住。

pairs.target: téng bǐ fāngcái gèngshēn , tā rěn zhe méi sōng , děng yǎnqián nà zhèn fāhēi guòqù , cái dītóu kàn .
pairs.english: The pain was even deeper than before; she endured it without letting go, waiting for the spell of blackness before her eyes to pass, and only then lowered her head to look.
pairs.hanzi: 疼比方才更深，她忍着没松，等眼前那阵发黑过去，才低头看。

pairs.target: bù de biānyán hěnkuài hóng le .
pairs.english: The edge of the cloth quickly turned red.
pairs.hanzi: 布的边沿很快红了。

pairs.target: tā yòu yājǐn yìxiē , lìngyìzhī shǒu zhuāzhù yībǎi , xiǎng sī chū tiáo bù lái .
pairs.english: She then pressed a little harder and caught her hem with the other hand, trying to tear off a strip of cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 她又压紧一些，另一只手抓住衣摆，想撕出条布来。

pairs.target: shībù chě bù kāi , shǒushàng fǎndǎo méi le lì .
pairs.english: The wet cloth wouldn’t tear, and her hand lost its strength instead.
pairs.hanzi: 湿布扯不开，手上反倒没了力。

pairs.target: tā zhǐhǎo fàngxià , jiāng shuǐnáng wǎng pángbiān tuī yuǎn , bèi dǐ zhe qiáng ,
pairs.english: She had to let go, push the waterskin farther aside and brace her back against the wall;
pairs.hanzi: 她只好放下，将水囊往旁边推远，背抵着墙，

pairs.target: cè guò shēn , ràng zhé hǎo de bù jiá zài shāngchù yǔ qiáng zhījiān .
pairs.english: turning sideways, she trapped the folded cloth between the wound and the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 侧过身，让折好的布夹在伤处与墙之间。

pairs.target: yìdiǎnyidiǎn dì , tā bǎshǒu chōu le chūlái .
pairs.english: Bit by bit, she drew out her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 一点一点地，她把手抽了出来。

pairs.target: bù méiyǒu diào .
pairs.english: The cloth didn't fall.
pairs.hanzi: 布没有掉。

pairs.target: tā bùgǎn zài dòng , étóu tiēzhe lěng shí , děng nà zhèn dǒu guòqù .
pairs.english: She dared not move again, forehead against the cold stone, waiting for the spell of trembling to pass.
pairs.hanzi: 她不敢再动，额头贴着冷石，等那阵抖过去。

pairs.target: shàngtóu shǐzhōng méiyǒu rénshēng .
pairs.english: There were still no voices above.
pairs.hanzi: 上头始终没有人声。

pairs.target: shuǐchōng guò zhuǎnjiǎo , hūrán xiǎng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Water rushed around the corner, suddenly splashing once.
pairs.hanzi: 水冲过转角，忽然响了一下。

pairs.target: tā táiqǐ yǎn , děng zhe hòumiàn yǒu jiǎobù , yǒu shéngzi pèng shítou , huòshì shào píng zài jiào yìshēng .
pairs.english: She raised her eyes, waiting for footsteps to follow, for rope to knock against stone, or for Shao Ping to call once again.
pairs.hanzi: 她抬起眼，等着后面有脚步，有绳子碰石头，或是邵平再叫一声。

pairs.target: děng le hěn jiǔ , zhǐyǒu nà jǐgēn cǎo zài shuǐ lǐ bǎi .
pairs.english: She waited a long time; only those few strands of grass swayed in the water.
pairs.hanzi: 等了很久，只有那几根草在水里摆。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shuǐnáng ná guòlái , nǐng le jǐcì cái kāi , hán le yìxiǎo kǒu .
pairs.english: She brought over the waterskin, twisted several times before it opened, then took a small mouthful.
pairs.hanzi: 她把水囊拿过来，拧了几次才开，含了一小口。

pairs.target: shuǐ cóng zuǐjiǎo lòu xiàqù , tā jímáng hélǒng zuǐ , děng yàn jìnqù le , cái bǎ gài chóngxīn nǐngjǐn .
pairs.english: Water leaked from the corner of her mouth; she hurriedly closed her lips and waited until she’d swallowed before screwing the cap tight again.
pairs.hanzi: 水从嘴角漏下去，她急忙合拢嘴，等咽进去了，才把盖重新拧紧。

pairs.target: háiyǒu shuǐ .
pairs.english: There was still water.
pairs.hanzi: 还有水。

pairs.target: yāodài yě zài .
pairs.english: The waist pouch was there too.
pairs.hanzi: 腰袋也在。

pairs.target: tā jiāng shèngxià de bǐng hé dòuzǐ sāi huí dài lǐ , fàngdào shǒu nénggòu zhe de dìfāng .
pairs.english: She tucked the remaining flatbread and beans back into the pouch and set it where her hand could reach.
pairs.hanzi: 她将剩下的饼和豆子塞回袋里，放到手能够着的地方。

pairs.target: shǒuzhǐ yìzhí zài dǒu , mō guò shí miàn shí , què bǐ fāngcái wěn le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Her fingers kept trembling, yet were a little steadier than before when they felt over the stone.
pairs.hanzi: 手指一直在抖，摸过石面时，却比方才稳了一点。

pairs.target: nà gǔ láilìbùmíng de rè méiyǒu zàiqǐ , yāo cè yě bìngwèi shǎo téng bànfēn .
pairs.english: The inexplicable heat had not returned, and the pain in her side had not eased in the slightest.
pairs.hanzi: 那股来历不明的热没有再起，腰侧也并未少疼半分。

pairs.target: tā dīxiàtóu , kànzhe zìjǐ chēng zài shí shàng de shǒu .
pairs.english: She lowered her head and looked at her own hand braced on the stone.
pairs.hanzi: 她低下头，看着自己撑在石上的手。

pairs.target: fāngcái míngmíng lián táiqǐ lái dōu nán .
pairs.english: Just before, it had clearly been so hard even to lift it.
pairs.hanzi: 方才明明连抬起来都难。

pairs.target: xìfèng lǐ de guāng àn le yízhèn , yòu jiànjiàn liàng huílái .
pairs.english: The light in the crack dimmed for a while, then gradually brightened again.
pairs.hanzi: 细缝里的光暗了一阵，又渐渐亮回来。

pairs.target: lín zhào méi zài shì zhe qǐshēn , zhī jiāng shuǐnáng tuī dào qiángbiān , liúchū néng luòxià shǒuzhǎng de yìxiǎokuài gān shí .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao didn't try to get up again; she only pushed the waterskin to the wall, leaving a small patch of dry stone where she could set her palm.
pairs.hanzi: 林照没再试着起身，只将水囊推到墙边，留出能落下手掌的一小块干石。

pairs.target: xià yícì yào nuódòng de shíhòu , shǒu dé chēng zài zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: The next time she had to move, her hand would have to brace right here.
pairs.hanzi: 下一次要挪动的时候，手得撑在这里。
